item.title: Petals, Privacy & Polish – November 2026 Update
item.content:encoded:
It has been an eventful couple of weeks since we announced Halcyon 17 Calla Lily. Following the initial bringup and our compute grant from ServerHive, our focus shifted toward refining the day-to-day experience.

Today, we're rolling out the November 2026 Update for Halcyon 17.0 (Android 17 QPR0), bringing requested customization features, privacy safeguards, smoother navigation, and key bug fixes.

What's New in Halcyon 17.0 (Android 17 QPR0)​

Customization & Launcher​

  • Icon Customization (Beta): Personalization is front and center. You can now apply third-party icon packs directly from your favorite icon makers to match your style.
  • Consistent App Shapes: We fixed an annoying visual quirk where icon masks differed across menus. Icon shapes are now strictly unified across the home screen, app drawer, recents screen, and app options.
  • Redesigned App Icon Menus: Long-pressing an app icon now smoothly opens an ergonomic bottom sheet instead of an awkward floating menu, keeping shortcuts easily within thumb's reach.
  • Smarter Theme Controls: To cut down on duplicate settings, the "Show app name" switch in Theme Picker now centrally controls both the home screen and app drawer labels.

Privacy & Security​

  • AppLock Privacy Boost: Protect sensitive apps with our new built-in AppLock using your biometric or device lock. For extra privacy, preview windows in the Overview/Recents screen are now automatically blurred for locked apps.
  • November 2026 Security Patch: Keeps your device safe with the latest security fixes merged from the upstream Android Open Source Project.

Navigation & Fluidity​

  • Optimized Gesture Navigation: The navigation hint bar now stays firmly pinned to the bottom during swipe-to-home gestures instead of jumping upwards into apps.
  • Smoother Animations: Refined app open and close physics for a more natural, fluid motion.
  • Refreshed Overview Screen: Enjoy a redesigned, modern background in your recents screen that blends seamlessly with your wallpaper.

Built-In Apps & Audio​

  • New Kilas Browser: Added Kilas, a lightweight and privacy-friendly web browser based on LineageOS Jelly, designed for quick link opening and zero-bloat browsing.
  • Standalone FM Radio: A clean, no-nonsense FM Radio app for supported devices to tune into local broadcasts offline.
  • Redesigned Halcyon Dolby: Updated the Dolby Atmos interface with a modern, cleaner look that makes tweaking audio profiles effortless.

Bug Fixes & Stability​

  • User Manager Fix: Resolved an issue where picking an avatar profile photo in User Manager caused an unexpected system crash.

Changelog Summary​

  • Launcher: Third-party icon pack support (Beta), consistent app shapes, bottom sheet app menus, unified theme controls.
  • Navigation & UI: Pinned gesture navigation hint bar, smoother animations, refreshed recents backdrop.
  • Privacy & Security: Built-in AppLock with recents preview blurring, November 2026 security patch.
  • Apps & Audio: Kilas browser (based on LineageOS Jelly), standalone FM Radio, redesigned Halcyon Dolby.
  • Fixes: Fixed avatar picker crash in User Manager.

Halcyon 16.2 (Android 16 QPR2)​

For devices on our Halcyon 16.2 branch (codenamed Bloom, based on Android 16 QPR2):

Status: To be updated

Maintainers are actively finalizing test builds and upstream patches for 16.2. Detailed release notes and build availability will be updated shortly.

Getting the Update​

Official builds are rolling out gradually across supported devices. Keep an eye on your device's built-in updater, or check your device's portal on our Wiki and announcement channels.

Thank you to all our testers and maintainers for your continuous feedback and support. Enjoy the update!

item.title: Enchanted by ServerHive
item.content:encoded:
We are glad to share that Halcyon has been selected as a grant recipient for the ServerHive Open Source Support Program (Season 2).

Through this program, ServerHive is providing us with compute infrastructure to help power our ongoing development.

Supporting the Open-Source Ecosystem​

Running an open-source Android project requires significant resources, and initiatives like the ServerHive OSS Support Program play a vital role in helping independent teams bring their ideas to life. By providing compute capacity to projects across the custom ROM and Android community, ServerHive is actively helping developers build, maintain, and innovate.

We’re really excited to have ServerHive backing us for this season. Huge thanks to their team for creating this program and stepping up to support open-source Android development.

If you are looking for fast, reliable, and affordable build servers tailored for developers, check out their official links below:

  • Instant Purchases: @ServerHive_Bot
  • Support: @ServerHiveSupport_bot
  • Updates & Announcement Channel: @ServerHive
  • OSS Program: ServerHive GitHub Repository

item.title: A New Home & A Fresh Bloom – Halcyon 17 Calla Lily
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to the official Halcyon blog! We are thrilled to launch this space as a central hub where we will share news, update logs, and insights into the development of Halcyon.

Along with opening this blog, we are excited to officially announce Halcyon 17, codenamed Calla Lily.

Special Thanks​

Reaching this milestone would not have been possible without the dedication and hard work of several key contributors.

We would like to extend our sincere thanks to:

  • Raya (rktdnt) for taking the initiative to lead the source code bringup.
  • Binzet and Naoko Shoto for creating stunning wallpapers and design assets.
  • Eren for generously covering our hosting infrastructure.
  • neroices for building and designing our new website.
  • Everyone who signed up for our Closed Beta Test. Your enthusiasm and early feedback mean a lot to us.

What is Coming Next?​

We are currently preparing for the upcoming Public Beta release.

Here is a quick look at what you can expect:

  • Feature Parity: Most of your favorite features from Halcyon 16.2 have already been ported over, and any remaining ones will be added soon.
  • Refreshed UI: We have given the user interface a subtle refresh for a cleaner and smoother experience.
  • More to Come: Additional customization and system enhancements are actively in development.

Source Code & Building​

For developers, maintainers, and enthusiasts looking to dive in, the source code for Halcyon 17 is now available and buildable!

If you would like to compile Halcyon for your device or start bringing up a new tree, please refer to our Wiki for complete guides on syncing the manifest, setting up your build environment, and compiling the source.

Stay tuned to this blog for future announcement posts, changelogs, and release schedules. Thank you for being part of the Halcyon community!
